Transform the supplied evidence photo into a complete raster case-file asset, preserving the photo as the mounted insert.
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: final raster asset for an in-game MISC > SPOOKTOBER case dossier. The WHOLE CASE FILE must be the generated image, including every printed word, paper, mounted photo, stamps and physical details. This is NOT a UI mockup. No interface widgets, no buttons, no glowing outlines, no digital panels, no screen. Make a convincing top-down archival military incident case folder with one cream paper report attached, physically textured fine paper fibers, slightly worn corners, restrained ink bleed, thin typewriter rules, one small red EYES ONLY stamp, one paperclip, authentic analogue case dossier art direction. Flat orthographic scan, no perspective distortion or dramatic shadows. Landscape 1536x1024, 3:2 composition, complete document almost fills canvas, transparent outside the paper silhouette, narrow safe margin. Excellent hierarchy: large bold subject title on right, mounted grainy evidence photograph on left about36%width, compact field notes and field orders on right. Printed labels and body text must be unusually large and readable after scaling image to 480 pixels wide: few lines, no tiny microcopy, no illegible filler. Entire document and all text INSIDE image. Do not include any dynamic state such as active/dormant/defeated/spawn/banish. The provided image is an evidence-photo reference for the mounted photograph only. Use that subject faithfully and integrate it into a polished complete case dossier. All specified text exactly once; no extra prose or invented serials.
